`__SQL_INSTANCE_ID__` has held disk utilization above 80% for fifteen minutes.

Storage auto-increase is on, so this is a COST alert before it is an availability alert — until the auto-increase limit set by `14-cloud-sql-hardening.sh` is reached, at which point it becomes an outage with no warning left.

1. Confirm the growth is data and not WAL or a runaway table.
2. `reliability-and-disaster-recovery.md` section 6 asks for "maximum-cost review" alongside auto-growth — raising the limit is a spend decision, not a shrug.
3. Cloud SQL storage cannot be shrunk. Growing it is permanent.

Source: reliability-and-disaster-recovery.md sections 6 and 17; runbooks.md gap list item 6.
